task_families.action: increase the rating of the identified source branch by a preregistered MVA increment
task_families.cost: preregistered fixed-plus-increment formula in synthetic benchmark units, with source digest, formula id, inputs, coefficients, and provenance retained

task_families.action: increase the rating of the identified source line by a preregistered MVA increment
task_families.cost: preregistered fixed-plus-line-length formula in synthetic benchmark units, with source digest, formula id, inputs, coefficients, and provenance retained

independence: separate source snapshots, generator functions, action namespaces, task instances, seeds, budgets, normalization references, and result rows; no pooled task-family inference

method.violation: max(0, (sum_j c_j*x_j - B)/B), with B finite and strictly positive
method.repair: repeat deletion of selected minimum benefit/cost action; exact ties by ascending action_id; stop at affordability
method.forward: add the affordable unselected maximum benefit/cost action; exact ties by ascending action_id
method.backward: delete the selected minimum benefit/cost action; exact ties by ascending action_id
method.atomic_substitution: provisionally delete the backward candidate and add the best affordable different action; evaluate once; accept or roll back both edits
method.acceptance: strict decrease in the frozen normalized-objective sum plus lambda times normalized violation; equality and non-finite values reject
method.pass_rule: first improvement with stop at the first non-improvement; no candidate, depth cap, request cap, or unique-evaluation cap also terminates
method.atomic_substitution_arm: separate optional factorial control; it must not be silently substituted for backward deletion

evaluation_accounting.cache_key: canonical binary phenotype within one task-family instance
evaluation_accounting.generated_requests: all requested candidate scorings, including duplicates
evaluation_accounting.unique_evaluations: cache misses scored once; this counter is the primary evaluation budget
evaluation_accounting.cache_hits: duplicate requests served from cached objective and violation values without a new unique charge
evaluation_accounting.termination_backstop: a separately frozen request cap prevents duplicate-only loops

security_semantics: none; grid reliability attributes and run records are not cybersecurity evidence
logging_semantics: counters and records are diagnostics only, not an audit mechanism, lineage proof, replay record, or explanation validation
